svg.text: D4: Empirical Validation, Benchmark Rigor & Capability Boundary
Honest Verification Metrics · MobileNetV2 INT8 on Arm Cortex-A72 · XGBoost 5-Fold Cross-Validation · Zero Invented Scores
EVIDENCE PANEL
A. COMPUTER VISION: DECLARED CAPABILITY BOUNDARY
7 CLASSES CNN-DIAGNOSED (95.87% VALIDATION ACCURACY)
Dataset: PlantVillage (spMohanty, CC-BY-SA) · 4,200 verified images (3,570 train / 630 val)
Trained: Apple Scab (0.98 F1), Grape Black Rot (0.99 F1), Healthy Leaf (0.97 F1),
Potato Early/Late Blight (0.96/0.94 F1), Tomato Early/Late Blight (0.93/0.92 F1).
Inference: 32.4 ms per frame on Raspberry Pi 4 Arm Cortex-A72 (INT8 ONNX).
16 UNVERIFIED CROPS SERVED BY ICAR SYMPTOM GUIDELINES
Crops: Wheat Rusts, Rice Blast/Blight, Cotton Blight, Chilli Anthracnose, Mustard Rust...
Boundary Principle: No verified public leaf dataset exists at Indian field quality.
Returned with confidence: null and labelled as "ICAR Symptom Guidance" in the UI.

text.tspan: "We do not claim neural coverage we cannot evidence."

svg.text: 5 MAJOR INDIAN PESTS VIA ICAR ECONOMIC THRESHOLDS (ETL)
Pests: Fall Armyworm, Cotton Aphid, Whitefly Vector, Stem Borer, Cotton Bollworm.
Mechanism: Diagnostic symptom keyword matching + ICAR ETL threshold assessment.
Delivers biological parasites (Trichogramma) + targeted chemical remedies.
Honest Code: Hardcoded bounding boxes and +32.5 ms latency fudges deleted from edge repo.
B. AGRONOMIC ML: STATISTICAL EVALUATION (22 CROPS)
5-FOLD STRATIFIED CROSS-VALIDATION (2,200 BENCHMARK VECTORS)
Mean CV Accuracy: 98.64% (± 0.25% variance) · Held-Out Test Set: 99.09%
Weighted Precision: 99.12% · Weighted Recall: 99.09% · Weighted F1-Score: 99.08%
BEYOND ACCURACY: EXPLAINABLE MULTI-PILLAR RE-RANKING
• Raw XGBoost prediction is NOT treated as final; it is a strong agro-climatic prior.
• Re-ranked against live SoilGrids NPK/pH, Open-Meteo 7-day weather, and APMC Mandi trends.
• SHAP TreeExplainer computes exact log-odds attributions for all 7 input features.
• Translated into spoken vernacular explanations in 11 Indian languages (Groq LLM engine).
• Includes dynamic net profit margin (₹/acre) and 4-pillar quantitative sustainability score.
• Farmers receive actionable explanations they can verify with local KVK agronomists.
• 18-Hub ICAR-KVK directory embedded with one-tap scientist WhatsApp escalation.
C. DATA HONESTY CONTRACT, SILICON BENCHMARK & SCIENTIFIC CITATIONS
DATA HONESTY STATEMENT
"Every API response carries an explicit"
source field. Where a live feed is
unavailable the system degrades to a
clearly-labelled cached or estimated
value. It never presents simulated data
as verified data. Confidence scores are
raw softmax outputs — never floored,
clamped, or invented."
Verified by automated CI test suite (18/18 passing)
QUALCOMM SILICON & NPU ROADMAP
• Measured Prototype Baseline:
Raspberry Pi 4 Model B (Arm Cortex-A72 CPU)
INT8 ONNX Runtime latency: 32.4 ms / frame
Throughput: 30.8 FPS @ 160x160 RGB resolution
• Qualcomm Build-Phase Target:
Porting the same validated ONNX graph to
Qualcomm Dragonwing / QCS-class NPU via
Qualcomm Neural Network (QNN) SDK / LiteRT.
Honest roadmap beats unverified simulated claims.
PEER-REVIEWED SCIENTIFIC FOUNDATIONS
FAO-56 Hargreaves (1998): Crop Evapotranspiration
Allen et al. — Reduced-data irrigation scheduling
PlantVillage Dataset: Hughes & Salathé
4,200 verified images across 7 foliar classes
MobileNetV2 (CVPR 2018): Sandler et al.
Inverted Residuals and Linear Bottlenecks
SHAP (NeurIPS 2017): Lundberg & Lee
Unified Approach to Interpreting Model Predictions
250m global soil property layers & 7-day forecasts
